# CryptoWeb (webcrypt60)

> Advanced Cryptography & Key Management Suite developed by WebTech60 Studio.

## Overview
CryptoWeb is a full-featured web application providing developers and security engineers with instant cryptographic operations:
- Hashing: MD5, SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA3-256, BLAKE2b, bcrypt
- Encryption: AES-256-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305, Fernet, 3DES, XOR, ROT13
- Encoding: Base64, Base32, Base85, Hex, Binary, URL, Morse
- Key Generation: Symmetric keys, passwords, RSA-2048, RSA-4096, ECC Ed25519 key pairs
- Secure Share: One-time burnable links with 24-hour TTL and Redis backend

## Pages & Applications
- [/] - Main landing page and WebTech60 feedback submission
- [/app] - Universal Cryptographic Terminal
- [/handbook] - Complete documentation and technical protocol specification

## API Endpoints
- [/api/process] - POST endpoint for data processing (hashing, encoding, encryption, formatting)
- [/api/generate-key] - POST endpoint for symmetric and asymmetric key generation
- [/api/share] - POST endpoint for burnable secure link creation
